source: Font file to draw PNG with, also embedded in SVG and HTML. It wins over every other font choice.
translation: 绘制 PNG 使用的字体文件，也会嵌入 SVG 和 HTML。它的优先级高于其他所有字体设置。

source: Go time layout the clock renders in (empty means 15:04:05); a layout without seconds refreshes once a minute
translation: 时钟使用的 Go 时间格式（留空表示 15:04:05）；不含秒的格式每分钟刷新一次

source: Highest frame rate tuios draws at. Your terminal and monitor can show fewer frames. A value above what they can show does not make tuios smoother. 0 uses 60. auto uses the refresh rate of your display. The range is 10 to 240.
translation: tuios 绘制画面的帧率上限。终端和显示器实际能显示的帧率可能更低，超过其显示能力不会更流畅。0 使用 60，auto 使用显示器刷新率。范围为 10 到 240。

source: Most KiB one pane's saved history takes on disk. 0 uses 2048. A change applies when the daemon next starts.
translation: 单个窗格的历史记录在磁盘上占用的最大 KiB 数。0 使用 2048。更改将在守护进程下次启动时生效。

source: Most history lines one pane saves. 0 uses 1000. A change applies when the daemon next starts.
translation: 每个窗格最多保存的历史行数。0 使用 1000。更改将在守护进程下次启动时生效。

source: Move the mouse left and right fast to turn the beam on and off. A shake does not move the beam. The follow setting decides where it goes
translation: 快速左右晃动鼠标可开关聚光灯。晃动不会改变聚光位置，位置由跟随设置决定

source: No alert for the focused pane while the terminal has focus
translation: 终端获得焦点时，不提醒当前窗格的状态

source: Offer a session in the rail that holds panes from several machines, once a second one is reachable
translation: 可连接第二台主机后，在侧边栏提供可容纳多台主机窗格的会话

source: One-cell glyph for the thumb. Empty uses the style's own.
translation: 滑块使用的单格字符。留空则使用样式默认字符。

source: One-cell glyph for the track, or none. Empty uses the style's own.
translation: 轨道使用的单格字符，或 none。留空则使用样式默认字符。

source: Open one terminal automatically when a session starts empty
translation: 空会话启动时自动打开一个终端

source: Open the preview panel after a capture
translation: 截图后打开预览面板

source: Open the review dialog on detection instead of only badging it
translation: 检测到项目脚本时自动打开审阅对话框

source: PNG size multiplier
translation: PNG 尺寸倍率

source: Percent of its light an unlit cell loses
translation: 未照亮区域的亮度降低百分比

source: Percent of its light the text around the hints loses
translation: 提示周围文字的亮度降低百分比

source: Pop a truncated workspace name in full on hover
translation: 悬停时完整显示被截断的工作区名称

source: Preferred rail width in columns
translation: 侧边栏首选宽度，单位为列

source: Preferred rail width in columns on a wide screen
translation: 宽屏下侧边栏的首选列宽

source: Punctuation that counts as part of a word for double-click selection
translation: 双击选择单词时视作单词组成部分的标点字符

source: Reverse the wheel direction in niri scrolling mode
translation: 反转 niri 滚动模式中的滚轮方向

source: Save each pane's history and show it again after a daemon restart. A change applies when the daemon next starts.
translation: 保存各窗格的历史记录，并在守护进程重启后重新显示。更改将在守护进程下次启动时生效。

source: Scroll a hovered row's overflowing title
translation: 悬停时滚动显示该行超出宽度的标题

source: Seconds a warning stays up. 0 uses the default.
translation: 警告通知的显示秒数。0 使用默认值。

source: Seconds an error stays up when error_sticky is false
translation: error_sticky 为 false 时，错误通知的显示秒数

source: Seconds an info message stays up. 0 uses the default.
translation: 信息通知的显示秒数。0 使用默认值。

source: Seconds between checks. 0 uses 2. A negative number turns checks off.
translation: 检测间隔秒数。0 使用 2，负数表示停止检测。

source: Seconds to wait. tuios drops the alert if the pane changes state.
translation: 提醒前等待的秒数。若窗格在此期间改变状态，则取消提醒。

source: Section names in the order the rail stacks them, each with an optional percent share. A name left out is a section the rail does not draw, and "spacer" is an empty block you may repeat.
translation: 按侧边栏排列顺序填写分区名，可为各区指定占比。未列出的分区不显示；"spacer" 表示空白区，可重复使用。

source: Selected text colour. Empty keeps the colour it already has.
translation: 所选文字的颜色。留空则保留原有颜色。

source: Send a desktop notification for mail. Unset follows notifications.agent.notify.
translation: 收到消息时发送桌面通知。未设置则沿用 notifications.agent.notify。

source: Send a desktop notification to the attached terminal
translation: 向已连接的终端发送桌面通知

source: Shell command to run on an alert. Empty runs nothing.
translation: 提醒时执行的 shell 命令。留空则不执行。

source: Shell that new panes run. Empty picks one for your platform.
translation: 新窗格使用的 Shell。留空则按当前平台自动选择。

source: Shortest gap between two sounds, in seconds. 0 uses 3.
translation: 两次声音提醒的最短间隔，单位为秒。0 使用 3。

source: Show RAM usage in the dock
translation: 在停靠栏显示内存用量

source: Show a mail alert in the dock. Unset follows notifications.agent.dock.
translation: 在停靠栏显示消息提醒。未设置则沿用 notifications.agent.dock。

source: Show a zoomed pane on the whole pane region with no border or title bar. Zoom size and zoom max width do not apply.
translation: 聚焦放大时占满窗格区域，不显示边框和标题栏。放大尺寸和最大宽度设置不再适用。

source: Show the CPU graph in the dock
translation: 在停靠栏显示 CPU 图表

source: Show the agent-state glyph on each rail row
translation: 在侧边栏每行显示智能体状态图标

source: Show the agent-state glyph on each row
translation: 在每行显示智能体状态图标

source: Show the agents section at the rail's bottom
translation: 在侧边栏底部显示智能体区域

source: Show the alert in the dock. Click it to go to the pane.
translation: 在停靠栏显示提醒，点击可跳转到对应窗格。

source: Show the clickable workspace strip in the dock
translation: 在停靠栏显示可点击的工作区标签栏

source: Show the clock overlay
translation: 显示时钟浮层

source: Show the on-screen keycast of recent keypresses
translation: 在屏幕上显示最近按下的按键

source: Show the session rail
translation: 显示会话侧边栏

source: Show the switch number ahead of each session name
translation: 在会话名称前显示切换编号

source: Show the terminals section
translation: 显示终端区域

source: Show the terminals section on the rail
translation: 在侧边栏显示终端区域

source: Show the which-key popup after the leader key
translation: 按下前缀键后显示快捷键提示弹窗

source: Show the window count on each session row
translation: 在每个会话行显示窗口数量

source: Side the master panes take in the master-stack layout. Center puts the stack on both sides.
translation: 主从布局中主窗格所在的位置。中央布局将从窗格放在两侧。

source: Slide a pane between its tile and the zoom box instead of swapping the two in one frame
translation: 窗格在平铺位置和放大位置之间滑动过渡

source: Space around the card in pixels
translation: 卡片周围留白，单位为像素

source: Start a new session tiled instead of floating. False when the config file has no [startup] table.
translation: 新会话以平铺模式启动。配置文件没有 [startup] 表时默认为关闭。

source: Start even when a pane is running a command or an agent
translation: 即使窗格正在运行命令或智能体，也启动屏幕保护

source: Start focused in terminal mode, when a window is present
translation: 有窗口时，启动后直接进入终端模式

source: Sweep a band of light over text that was just copied. Set motion to none to turn it off.
translation: 在刚复制的文字上播放扫光。将 motion 设为 none 可关闭。

source: Text colour of a search match. Empty keeps the colour it has.
translation: 搜索匹配项的文字颜色。留空则保留原有颜色。

source: Text colour of the match the cursor is on. Empty keeps it.
translation: 光标所在匹配项的文字颜色。留空则保留原有颜色。

source: Text colour under the copy mode cursor. Empty keeps it.
translation: 复制模式光标下的文字颜色。留空则保留原有颜色。

source: The click that opens a link: ctrl or shift, ctrl only, shift only, or none
translation: 打开链接所需的点击方式：ctrl 或 shift、仅 ctrl、仅 shift，或 none

source: The command that opens a web link. If this is empty, tuios uses $BROWSER, then the system opener.
translation: 打开网页链接的命令。留空时先使用 $BROWSER，再使用系统默认程序。

source: The format multi copy mode yanks in: plain, markdown or json
translation: 多窗格复制模式的输出格式：plain、markdown 或 json

source: The hints key labels every pane on the workspace, not only the focused pane
translation: 提示键为工作区所有窗格显示标签

source: The light the copy sweep is made of
translation: 复制扫光的颜色

source: The shape the copy sweep takes
translation: 复制扫光的形状

source: The size of a session with more than one client: the smallest client, the largest client, or the client that last had input
translation: 多客户端会话的尺寸依据：最小客户端、最大客户端，或最近输入的客户端

source: The terminal editor that opens a text file. If this is empty, tuios uses $EDITOR, then $VISUAL, then vi.
translation: 打开文本文件的终端编辑器。留空时依次尝试 $EDITOR、$VISUAL 和 vi。

source: Tiling scheme a new session starts in. An existing session keeps its own.
translation: 新会话的初始平铺方案。现有会话保留自己的方案。

source: Title bar text, with {title}, {index} and {cwd} tokens
translation: 标题栏文字，支持 {title}、{index} 和 {cwd} 占位符

source: Title template accepting {title}, {index} and {cwd}
translation: 标题模板，支持 {title}、{index} 和 {cwd}

source: Try to copy the capture to the clipboard
translation: 尝试将截图复制到剪贴板

source: Turn every agent alert on or off
translation: 开关所有智能体提醒

source: Turn mail alerts on or off. Unset follows notifications.agent.enabled.
translation: 开关消息提醒。未设置则沿用 notifications.agent.enabled。

source: Type in a pane when a keyboard focus command moves to it: off, targeted (select and arrows), or all (including Tab)
translation: 通过键盘切换焦点后直接输入：off、targeted（选择和方向键），或 all（也包括 Tab）

source: Up on a list's first row goes to its last, and down on the last goes to the first
translation: 列表首行按上移到末行，末行按下移到首行

source: Wash behind the card: auto derives it from the theme; none, a hex color, or hex..hex work too
translation: 卡片背后的底色：auto 从主题生成；也可使用 none、十六进制颜色或 hex..hex 渐变

source: What a click on a folder row does
translation: 点击文件夹行时执行的操作

source: What a click on a pane's content does in window-management mode
translation: 窗口管理模式下点击窗格内容时执行的操作

source: What happens on entering a directory with a project tape
translation: 进入包含项目自动化脚本的目录时执行的操作

source: What happens when a program in a pane sets the clipboard: off, ask, focused (the focused pane only, others ask) or on
translation: 窗格程序设置剪贴板时的处理方式：off、ask、focused（仅当前窗格直接写入，其他窗格询问）或 on

source: What the beam follows: the mouse, or the focused pane's cursor. The cursor sends fewer bytes to a remote client
translation: 聚光灯跟随鼠标或当前窗格的光标。跟随光标时，发送到远程客户端的数据更少

source: When the last pane on the workspace on screen closes, show the workspace you came from. Off shows the splash screen
translation: 当前工作区最后一个窗格关闭后，返回先前的工作区。关闭此项则显示欢迎画面

source: When window borders are hidden: never, always, or while the mouse is idle
translation: 窗口边框隐藏时机：从不、始终，或鼠标空闲时

source: When you switch to a workspace with no panes, open a new pane there. It starts in the folder of the pane you came from
translation: 切换到空工作区时自动新建窗格，并使用原窗格的工作目录

source: Where a delete sends the file: the trash, or nowhere
translation: 删除文件时移到回收站，或直接永久删除

source: Where copy mode puts its cursor: on the terminal cursor or in the center
translation: 复制模式的初始光标位置：终端光标处或中央

source: Which effect runs, or random for a different one each time
translation: 使用的效果，random 表示每次随机选择

source: Which end of the title bar the window controls sit on
translation: 窗口控制按钮位于标题栏哪一端

source: Width in cells of a zoomed pane. 0 fills the screen.
translation: 聚焦放大的窗格列宽。0 表示占满屏幕。

source: Width of a column in the scrolling layout, as a percent of the screen
translation: 滚动布局中每列宽度占屏幕的百分比

source: Width of the master pane in the master-stack layout, as a percent of the screen
translation: 主从布局中主窗格宽度占屏幕的百分比

source: Width of the picture-in-picture view, border included, in cells
translation: 画中画宽度，包含边框，单位为列

source: Width of the scratch terminal, in cells (60) or percent (80%)
translation: 临时终端宽度，可用列数（60）或百分比（80%）表示

source: Window control marks: the macOS lights, your glyph set, or none
translation: 窗口控制标记：macOS 指示灯、当前字符样式，或 none

source: Window controls as a filled pill or as macOS traffic lights
translation: 窗口控制按钮使用实心胶囊样式或 macOS 红黄绿灯样式

source: With one master on the left, show four or more panes as a grid
translation: 左侧只有一个主窗格时，四个及以上窗格以网格排列

source: Workspace chip band the rail used to draw
translation: 原侧边栏中的工作区标签栏

source: Workspace tab template accepting {index} and {name} (empty: {name})
translation: 工作区标签模板，支持 {index} 和 {name}（留空为 {name}）
